entries.note: SeedAsync saves the catalog brands; the staged seeding continues with two more SaveChangesAsync calls on the same context, which is exactly the repeated-save shape LC039 flags. Batching is a deliberate product decision for staged seeding, so the diagnostic is acknowledged rather than acted on.
Second staged SaveChangesAsync (catalog types) after the brands save in the same method.
roleManager.Roles.All(...) enumerates the roles query synchronously inside an async method instead of awaiting an AnyAsync-style counterpart.
userManager.Users.All(...) enumerates the users query synchronously inside an async method.
context.TodoLists.Any() executes a synchronous existence query inside an async method; AnyAsync is the direct counterpart.
